g.text: Spherical starlet coefficient maps per scale — shell 25, z = 0.41: fine scales (left) carry small-scale detail, coarse scales (right) the smooth field. Bottom row = difference (independent realisations → uncorrelated, full amplitude retained) (nside 512)
